# Icon

One Font Awesome Free glyph, drawn from its name. - **name** is a Free name: regular where Free has a regular weight, solid where it does not. A name that carries its family (`fa-brands fa-slack`) is kept. - **size** is 12, 16 or 24, each bound to its icon size token. Without it the glyph is the small icon size, or the size the component around it sets. - **color** is an icon color role. Without it the glyph takes the color around it. - **label** names the icon for assistive technology. Without it the icon is hidden, so the words beside it carry the meaning.

**Import:** `import { Icon } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Icon/Icon.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/images-and-icons/Icon/Icon.stories.jsx` — Names, Sizes, Colors, Inherited, Labeled, InAComponent, Interactive, Rest

## Usage

Pass the icon's name to the component that shows it. Where no component takes the name, draw it with Icon:

```jsx
import { Icon } from '@/components';

<Icon name="calendar-days" size={16} color="subtle" />
<Icon name="circle-check" size={16} color="success" label="Approved" />
```

Use a glyph's current name: an alias is not in the regular list, so it draws solid. Only the Free families draw: `fa-solid`, `fa-regular` and `fa-brands`.

## Best practices

### Pair it with words, or give it a `label`. {#pair-it-with-words-or-give-it-a-label}

Without `label` the icon is hidden from assistive technology, so the words beside it carry the meaning.

Do: The icon beside the words it backs up.
Don't: An icon alone with no label, so it has no name.

### Color it with a role, never a picked color. {#color-it-with-a-role-never-a-picked-color}

Do: The success role for a success mark.
Don't: The brand role on a status mark.

## Accessibility

- **Labeled or hidden.** With `label` the icon is `role="img"` named by it. Without, it is `aria-hidden`.
- **An icon-only control is named by the control.** Icon button takes a required `label`, and the glyph inside stays hidden.

## Parts

1. **Glyph.** An `i` element with the family and name classes. With `size` it is a square box of that size; without, it is the small icon size, or the size the component around it sets.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | The only state. An icon is a picture, not a control. |
| Hovered, pressed, focused, disabled | None. Put the icon inside a control, which carries them. |

### Tokens

| Prop | Value | Token |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | 12 · 16 · 24 | `--icon-sm` · `--icon-md` · `--icon-lg` |
| `color` | `default` · `subtle` · `subtlest` | `--ds-icon` · `--ds-icon-subtle` · `--ds-icon-subtlest`: beside body text, beside a label, beside metadata. |
| `color` | `success` · `warning` · `danger` · `information` · `discovery` | The status icon tokens, such as `--ds-icon-danger`. |
| `color` | `brand` · `selected` · `disabled` · `inverse` · `warning-inverse` | The brand, selected and disabled icon tokens, and the inverse pair for a bold background. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `name` | string (required) | — | A Font Awesome Free name, such as `calendar-days`, or a name with its family. |
| `size` | enum | — | The size in px, bound to an icon size token. Unset, the glyph is the small icon size, or the size the component around it sets. |
| `color` | enum | — | An icon color role. Unset, the glyph takes the color around it. |
| `label` | string | — | An accessible name. Without it the icon is hidden from assistive technology. |
| `className` | string | — | More classes for the glyph, beside the family and name classes. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the glyph. |
